newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURK TREASURY TO AUCTION INFLATION-INDEXED BONDS.
newsitem.headline: TURK TREASURY TO AUCTION INFLATION-INDEXED BONDS.

text.p: The Turkish treasury will auction two-year inflation-indexed bonds on Tuesday, the central bank said.
The inflation-times-risk premium bond will bring its holder a return equal to the year-on-year consumer price inflation multiplied by a risk premium which will be determined at the auction.
Interest will be paid every three months, based on the year-on-year inflation on the date of payment.
Maturity: March 5, 1999 Amount: - Auction date: March 4, 1997
